title: Using AI for project updates without losing the facts
summary: Where an AI draft can save time, and what a project manager still needs to verify before sharing it.

sources.title: PMI
sources.description: Background on AI-assisted planning, reporting and communication.

sections.title: Start with the project record
sections.text: A weekly update is a sensible place to try AI-assisted drafting. Begin with approved inputs such as the action log, decision register and the current schedule. Ask the tool to separate open decisions from completed work, and tell it to mark missing information.

sections.title: Keep accountability with the project team
sections.text: Check each proposed owner, date and status against the source. If someone’s update is ambiguous, confirm it with them before sharing the draft. Follow your organisation’s rules on what project information can be entered into AI tools.

sections.imageAlt: A desk with a computer, keyboard and handwritten project notes

sections.title: Build an example for your portfolio
sections.text: Save an anonymised before-and-after example. Describe how you verified dates and numbers and how the final update helped someone make a decision.

title: What to look for in a project coordinator role in Bangladesh
summary: A practical guide to reading role descriptions and showing evidence of coordination skills.
intro: Read each role description carefully and identify the coordination responsibilities that you can demonstrate with your own experience.

sections.title: Evidence of coordination
bullets: Describe how you tracked actions and deadlines.
Explain how you coordinated stakeholders and communicated progress.
Use examples of issues you helped resolve, without inventing results.

title: Agile delivery skills you can demonstrate in an interview
summary: How to talk about planning, feedback and team delivery with examples from your own work.
intro: Use examples from your own work to explain how you supported planning, feedback and team delivery.

sections.title: Prepare practical examples
bullets: Explain how the team planned work and adjusted to new information.
Describe how feedback influenced the next steps.
Discuss your contribution to delivery and what you learned.

title: Global Demand for Project Managers Expected to Grow 28% in 2025
articleTitle: Project Management Job Demand to Grow 28% in 2025
articleLead: Global demand for PM professionals continues to rise, especially in Tech, Healthcare, and Green Energy projects.
summary: New industry findings show continued growth in PM roles across Tech, Healthcare, and Green Energy sectors.
intro: The demand for Project Management (PM) professionals is expected to grow by around 28% in 2025, according to recent industry reports. Organizations across technology, healthcare, and green energy sectors are investing in more projects, creating new opportunities for skilled PMs.

sections.title: Why the Demand Is Rising
sections.text: Businesses are running more complex, digital, and cross-functional projects. This has increased the need for professionals who can plan, coordinate, manage risks, and ensure successful delivery.

sections.title: What It Means for You
sections.text: This is a great time to build or strengthen your project management skills. Gaining hands-on experience, learning Agile/Hybrid approaches, and pursuing relevant certifications (such as PMP® or CSM®) can increase your career opportunities in 2025 and beyond.

title: Top 5 Project Management Challenges in 2025 (and How to Overcome Them)
summary: From resource constraints to rapid technology change—explore practical ways to stay ahead.
intro: Project managers balance changing requirements, resources and stakeholder expectations while keeping teams aligned.

sections.title: Common project challenges
bullets: Timely decisions across teams and stakeholders.

sections.title: How to respond
sections.text: Make risks visible early, communicate trade-offs clearly and adapt plans based on evidence and team feedback.

title: Green & Sustainable Projects: A Growing Opportunity for Project Managers
summary: Sustainability and ESG-focused projects are creating new demand for PM skills across industries.
intro: Sustainability-focused projects often bring together technology, regulation, local communities and multiple delivery partners.

sections.title: Project management opportunities
sections.text: Green energy and sustainability initiatives benefit from strong stakeholder coordination, risk planning and measurable project outcomes.

sections.title: What It Means for You
